sales.heroSubtitle: MedSociety is a bilingual directory of medical care across the US–Mexico border, in El Paso – Ciudad Juárez and San Diego – Tijuana. Patients crossing in either direction use it to compare clinics, ratings and published prices, then contact a clinic directly.
sales.howTitle: Three steps to your first patient
sales.howSubtitle: No contracts, no setup fee, and nothing to install. Most clinics finish in one sitting.
sales.step1Body: Clinic name, specialties, address, phone. That is the whole form, and it takes about five minutes.
sales.step2Body: Your clinic appears to patients searching your specialty in your city, whether they live nearby or are crossing the border, in English and Spanish.
sales.step3Body: We report how many people opened your profile each month, so you know what the listing is doing.
sales.cityElPasoBody: Patients searching for local dentists, primary care, urgent care and specialists, plus those comparing prices across the bridge.
sales.cityJuarezBody: Clinics serving both local patients and the steady flow of US visitors crossing for dental, vision and elective care.
sales.citySanDiegoBody: Patients looking for local doctors and specialists, plus patients from Mexico crossing north for US care and second opinions.
sales.cityTijuanaBody: Dentists, plastic surgeons and specialists serving local patients and visitors from Southern California and beyond who cross for care.
sales.mapArtLabel: Illustrated map of clinics on both sides of the US–Mexico border at El Paso – Ciudad Juárez and San Diego – Tijuana
sales.pricingTitle: Free to list. Pay only to stand out.
sales.pricingSubtitle: Every clinic gets a full listing at no cost. Promotion is optional and month to month.
sales.freeF1: Your clinic on the MedSociety map
sales.freeF4: Shown to English and Spanish searches
sales.proF2: Gold pin, sized larger on the map
sales.proF4: Full analytics on views and calls
sales.proF5: Included in the weekly patient digest

sales.ctaBannerSubtitle: Patients are already searching your specialty in your city. Make sure your clinic is what they find.

pricing.terms: No setup fee, no contract, cancel whenever you want.
pricing.addonsTitle: Fill the schedule, not just the listing
pricing.addonsSubtitle: Being found is the first half. These are the services that turn a profile view into an appointment that shows up and pays.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp and AI chat
whatsapp.body: Automatic replies, online booking, and messages shared fairly across your staff. Hand any conversation to a person at any point.

payments.title: Online payments and prepay links
payments.body: Send a payment link over WhatsApp or SMS. Cards and digital wallets in USD and MXN, automatic receipts, and deposits that stop no-shows.

website.title: Professional website
website.body: A mobile-first site with your services, prices and booking, your Google Business profile set up, and domain and hosting managed for you.

reminders.title: Reminders and campaigns
reminders.body: Appointment reminders, up to four campaigns a month, and reactivation for patients you have not seen in a while. Messaging fees at cost.

seo.title: SEO and AI visibility audit
seo.body: Where you show up in search, maps and AI assistants, how you compare with the clinics near you, and what to fix first. Included quarterly with Featured.

account.communityBody: Ask your question free and get answers from verified doctors and clinics in El Paso – Ciudad Juárez and San Diego – Tijuana.
account.signInBody: Manage your clinic’s listing, photos and plan.
account.signUpBody: One account manages every listing you claim. Free, and it stays free.
account.messageBody: Create a free account to send your message to the clinic. It will be waiting for you when you're back.
account.checkInboxBody: We sent a confirmation link to {{email}}. Open it and you are in.
account.claimBody: Tell us how we can confirm you work here. A person reviews every claim, usually within one business day.
account.claimSentBody: We will review it and email you. Nothing changes on your listing until it is approved.
account.claimNotFoundBody: That link points at a clinic we no longer hold.
account.evidenceHint: A work email on the clinic’s domain, a cédula profesional, or the phone number already on the listing.
account.evidencePlaceholder: I am the office manager. Our phone on this listing is my direct line, and my email is on our domain.
account.dashboardSubtitle: Everything on your listing, and what your plan includes.
account.noClinicBody: Find your practice in the directory and claim it. It takes a minute and it costs nothing.
account.pendingBody: A person is checking your claim. We will email you as soon as it is approved.
account.statsDisclaimer: Views and contacts are estimates, modelled from search demand for your specialty and area — not measured traffic. We will replace them with real figures as soon as tracking is live.
account.gapTitle: People are finding you and leaving
account.gapBody: We estimate around {{views}} people looked at this listing in the last month, and none of them had a contact button to press. A promoted listing adds one.
account.fieldAddressHint: Shown on your listing. Changing it does not move your pin.
account.fieldDescriptionHint: A short paragraph patients read before they call. What you treat, who you are, what to expect.
account.fieldLanguagesHint: Shown on your listing, and patients can filter by it. Leave both unchecked if you'd rather not say yet.
account.locationNote: Need to move your pin on the map, change your specialty, or correct your rating? Email hello@medsociety.one — those are set by us so a listing cannot quietly relocate itself.
account.photosBody: Clinics with real photos get opened far more often than ones without. These appear on your listing, and the first is the cover.
account.photoTooBig: That file is over 5 MB. Please upload a smaller image.

account.avatarBody: The round photo patients see on search cards and at the top of your page: a logo, or a clear portrait of you. This is separate from the gallery, where your other photos go.
account.avatarSpecs: JPG, PNG or WebP. You can crop it before it uploads.
account.avatarBadType: Use a JPG, PNG or WebP image.
account.avatarTooBig: That file is too large (12 MB max).
account.avatarReadError: We could not read that image. Try a different file.
account.cropHint: Drag to reposition, use the slider to zoom.
account.languagesIntro: Patients can filter by language. Choose everything your team can comfortably speak with patients.
account.languagesNotSpecified: Not specified yet. Your listing shows no languages until you choose.
account.languagesNoneConfirmed: You have confirmed that no languages are listed.
account.socialIntro: Add the accounts patients can find you on. Type a handle, paste a link, or (for WhatsApp) enter the number with country code. We tidy it into a clean link.

socialErr.invalid: That does not look like a valid {{label}} handle or link.
socialErr.wrong_network: That link is from {{network}}. Paste your {{label}} link here instead.
socialErr.needs_country_code: Include the country code, for example +52 for Mexico or +1 for the US.
socialErr.needs_url: Paste your full LinkedIn link (linkedin.com/in/... or linkedin.com/company/...).

account.galleryVsAvatarBody: These are the extra photos on your listing: your waiting room, team, treatments. Your profile picture is a different, single round photo you set in the Profile tab.
account.photoDropHint: JPG, PNG or WebP, up to {{max}} photos. Large photos are resized for you.
account.photosLimit: The gallery holds up to {{max}} photos.
account.photosEmptyBody: Clinics with real photos of the space and team get opened far more often. Add at least three.
account.photosReorderHint: Drag photos to reorder them. The first one is your cover.
account.completeBody: {{done}} of {{total}} done. Complete listings get more patient contacts.

forum.onlyDoctorsBody: Every answer comes from a clinic or practitioner who has claimed their MedSociety listing.
forum.disclaimerShort: Answers are general information from verified clinicians, not a diagnosis. In an emergency, call 911.
forum.disclaimer: Answers on MedSociety are general information shared by verified clinicians and are not a substitute for an in-person consultation, diagnosis or treatment. If you think you have a medical emergency, call 911 in the US or Mexico.

ask.lede: Ask anything about your health, a treatment, or getting care on the other side of the border. Doctors and clinics with verified MedSociety listings answer, for free.
ask.areYouDoctor: Are you a doctor? Answer questions
ask.doctorBannerBody: Each answer shows your clinic and links to your profile, so every patient who reads it can find you.
ask.emptyBody: Be the first to ask. A verified doctor will answer.

society.title: The Med Society
society.lede: A private room for clinicians in El Paso – Ciudad Juárez and San Diego – Tijuana. Answer the questions we send out, trade what’s working in your practice, and get to know colleagues on both sides of the line.
society.emptyBody: Start the first discussion. Your colleagues will see it here.
society.gateBody: A members-only forum for doctors and clinics with a verified MedSociety listing. Claim your listing to join. It’s free.
